Jane / team —

Quick legal note after an initial pass on the SOW redlines: three small items we flagged that affect execution timing:
1) Data retention clause: we can accept the 90-day audit-retention request as-is, but need a sign-off from your security lead (simple confirmation email is OK).
2) SLA appendix: we proposed an appendix that defines the canary SLA (30-day probation). That appendix is non-blocking but should be attached prior to signature.
3) Payment terms: standard net-30; if Stellar requires net-45 we need explicit approval from finance which can add ~3 business days.

Recommendation: target DocuSign send on May 17, signature by May 18. That gives procurement one business day to insert a PO number and Rishi can cut the invoice same day. Proposed start date (production kube/network access): June 7 for canary; June 21 for full rollout. If they confirm PO earlier we can move canary to June 1.
